{{Quote|Sir, they're hardly our best-armed ships.''"<br />"''But they're the only ones who can keep up with us, aren't they?|[[Dankin]] and Karrde|<ref name="EOV1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Sudden Demise''''', also known as the '''''Demise''''', was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] chief and [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]], [[Talon Karrde]]. The vessel was fast, but it was not heavily armed or defended. It flamed out in the first exchange of the [[Invasion of Yavin 4]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The crew was presumably lost.

It, along with [[Idiot's Array (starship)|''Idiot's Array'']] and the ''[[Etherway]]'', escorted the ''[[Wild Karrde]]'' during the battle because, although they weren't heavily armed, they were the only vessels that could keep up with their [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]].
